notes.title: Makersmas Returns!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/e7757d82ba80b41abbf51a91ce07d4ee9c807805.jpg[/img]

Happy Makersmas, everybody! This is our fourth annual Festival of Creativity. In the past, we've celebrated by hosting art contests, boosted in-game Gems by pushing social media hashtags, and challenged you to create holiday-themed levels using [i]Mondrian Maker [/i] and [i]Mondrian Studio[/i]. This year, we want you to celebrate Makersmas [i]your[/i] way.

What does a Festival of Creativity mean to you? Does it mean undertaking a new project for the month? Trying your hand at a new form of art? Finding new avenues to share your or others' creative works? Learning a new tool?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/9b873d55e7c23dda5e6ff46b17700342bc778f10.jpg[/img]
Anyone can Create! So whatever you make, as always, use our community during Makersmas as YOUR community. Share your endeavors, make some new fans, and be creative!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/e797029cfbfc40dea3df658351b2a2e9cf287bfb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/f564d3bf0e9fed910dc7fcc34005cb5b7dcc3192.jpg[/img]
To celebrate on our end, we've added our annual Makersmas decorations to the Museum, including six new Spotlight Artworks. This is also the only month of the year when you can earn the Makersmas Riches, Goodies, and Avarice Achievements by opening your free Daily Presents from each of the trees in the Museum. The Gift Tree will give you a free daily cosmetic (Spotlight Artworks, Pedestals, Walls, Floors, Ceilings, Baseboards, or Columns), while the Gem Tree will give you free daily Gems (300, 500, 1000, 2000, or 3000). So make the most of this Makersmas and Get. Those. Gifts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/e797029cfbfc40dea3df658351b2a2e9cf287bfb.png[/img]
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Museum: [/b]Added new Spotlight Cosmetics.
  - [b]Makersmas:[/b] Menorah, Snowman, Polar Bear, Yeti, Tower of Presents, Frozen Fountain
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Added the last year’s-worth of cosmetics to the Gift Tree for Makersmas.[/list][h3]Changes[/h3]
[list] 
[*] [b] Museum: [/b] Updated the look of the Nutcracker spotlight artwork[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/e797029cfbfc40dea3df658351b2a2e9cf287bfb.png[/img]
[h1]Signing Off[/h1]
As always, we want to wish you all a very happy holiday season and a happy New Year! We're signing off for the rest of 2023 but we will see you in 2024!

[i]- Danny[/i]

notes.title: Art Hallow's Eve 2023 has Begun! Join in our annual Spooky Celebration.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/63af875a8624a524d3a2ea3dc40dfa8a0766507d.jpg[/img]
[h1]Art Hallow's Eve Has Begun[/h1]
Good morning to you all! The leaves are falling on [i]Mondrian[/i]'s main menu, and that can only mean one thing: our annual spooky celebration has begun, and with it, we've published the latest update for [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i], version 1.5.1. Here are the latest patch notes:

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Added new Spotlight Cosmetics.
[list]
[*]    [b]Art Hallow’s Eve:[/b] Gargoyle, Scarecrow, Grim Reaper, Witch, Pile of Skulls, Fat Bat, Headless Horseman, Black Cat, Vampiric Fountain, The Monster, Werewolf, and Mr. Bones.
[*]    [b]Museum:[/b] Added new Construction Cosmetics.
[*]    [b]Walls:[/b] Strand Board Wall.
[*]    [b]Ceilings:[/b] Strand Board Ceiling.
[/list][*] [b]Game:[/b] Added “A Master Trickster” Achievement to Steam version. Survive 10 rounds of Tricks in Spooky Gem Hunt mode to get it![/list][h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Menu:[/b] Adjusted the gray value for Art Hallow’s Eve Razer™ Chroma RGB lighting.
[/list]
This patch is now available on all platforms.

[h1]Spooky Celebrations[/h1]
It would not be Art Hallow's Eve without our annual community celebrations! This year we're mixing things up with different creative contests and LOTS of key giveaways! Read on to see how you can get involved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/2b118cd13b16d1cb4d793f0036feeaabb28318b8.jpg[/img]
[h2]Third Annual Pumpkin Carving Contest[/h2]
Mondrian's oldest community event returns! Use one of our Pumpkin templates or design your own in Mondrian Maker to make the best jack-o-lantern! Players can participate in the Free Admission demo or Lifetime Pass versions of the game. Submit your jack-o-lanterns onto [url=https://mod.io/g/mondrian]mod.io[/url] or Steam Workshop with the "Art Hallow's Eve" Gala Entry tag to enter. Three winners total will be picked by the community (so Like your favorites). Be sure to share them on social media using #artHallowsEve and mention @lantanagames to rack up those Likes. Submissions open through 10/30 and votes tallied 10/31!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/d9413d4f8f73a491924f8b420f49a016d974dd56.jpg[/img]
[h2]Haunted House Contest[/h2]
Decorate your Museum into the best spooky space possible! You may use any cosmetics you feel would make the best haunted house. Due to Adventure Mode not being available in the demo, the Haunted House Contest is only open to Lifetime Pass players. Post your screenshots on social media (in particular, Twitter/X, Threads, or Instagram) using #artHallowsEve and mention @lantanagames. Three winners total will be picked by the community (so Like your favorites). Submissions open through 10/30 and votes tallied 10/31!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/06f2b1f6a49c86a29df0f2b0c3e6de040a99b894.jpg[/img]
[h2]Costume Contest[/h2]
For anyone who still doesn't have their Halloween costume ready, why not dress up as one of our world famous artists?! Design your costume of Piet, Sophie, Hale, Andy, Lois, or even Ariko and share it in photo or video form on social media using #artHallowsEve and mention @lantanagames (Twitter/X, Threads, or Instagram). This costume can even be digital, so if you think you can dress up your VR Chat avatar or your Sea of Thieves pirate or your Minecraft Steve or whoever as one of our artists, go for it! Voted by the community and open to everyone regardless of if you have any version of the game downloaded. Three winners total! Submissions through 10/30 and votes tallied 10/31!

[img]https://media.tenor.com/t_3mMoTL_-AAAAAC/im-so-startled-randy-marsh.gif[/img]
[h2]"I Am So Startled" Contest[/h2]
One for the content creators! Play Spooky Gem Hunt on stream or in a video and send us your best clips of getting got by the Tricks. Go overboard with it! The bigger the reaction, the better. You will need either the Free Admission demo or the Lifetime Pass version of the game to play Spooky Gem Hunt. Share the clips on social media (Twitter/X, Threads, or Instagram), using #artHallowsEve and mention @lantanagames. Three winners total will be picked by the community (so Like your favorites). Submissions through 10/30 and votes tallied 10/31!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/96bbe5da95ee3da24cf51de6fdcce938a9da0bb2.jpg[/img]
[h1]But what are the prizes?[/h1]
To keep things simple, all contests will have the same prize packs:
[list]
[*] [b]1st Place:[/b] Gold Frame, Mondrian Series Bundle including all games and DLC's in the series (itch.io or Steam keys)
[*] [b]2nd Place:[/b] Silver Frame, 2 Mondrian Steam or itch.io keys of your choice (Games or DLC's)
[*] [b]3rd Place:[/b] Bronze Frame, 1 Mondrian Steam or itch.io key of your choice (Game or DLC)[/list]The keys are self-explanatory, and for the frames, we will send you a customized version of your screenshot, thumbnail, or photo with the winning frame around it so you can display it proudly!

Happy Art Hallow's Eve, everybody. Please enjoy the update, and we can't wait to see what you cook up this month!

- Danny

notes.title: Mondrian - Plastic Reality version 1.5.0 Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/1c069b31053d1db5962f893b318d83a8687ce92d.jpg[/img]
Good morning, everybody! Today I'm very pleased to announce that the latest update for [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i], 1.5.0, is now available on Steam for both Free Admission and Lifetime Pass users. This update is [i]heavily[/i] built around improving the experience in [i]Mondrian Maker[/i], particularly on controllers. Nearly all - if not actually all - missing controller functionality has been accounted for, and even includes some functions not available on keyboard and mouse, such as boosting and slowing the cursor speed with the shoulder bumpers.

As well as the above additions to [i]Mondrian Maker[/i], we've added the requisite bug fixes and some new cosmetics to the Museum! See the patch notes below for more details.
[h2]Game[/h2]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Added new Spotlight Cosmetics
[b] - Porcelain:[/b] Angel, Sea Siren, Antonin the Dragon, Horse, Tortoise, and Elephant.
 [b]- World:[/b] Anubis, Seated Monkey, Ocelot Cuauhxicalli, Resting Goat, Ocelot Warrior, Ganesh.
 [b]- Plantlife:[/b] Areca Palm, Cristina’s Sunflowers, Rose Bush, Maidenhair Fern, Purple Orchid, Fig Tree.
 [b]- Retro Tech:[/b] Red Phone, Typewriter, Gamething 2000, Gramophone, Daguerreotype, and Dorm TV.
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] The “Black Ornate” Wallpaper is now just “Ornate” Wallpaper and is fully paintable! If you had the Black Ornate wallpaper on already, it will still load just as it was.
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Added “Oriented Strand Board” floor
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Added the “Rijksmuseum Collection,” including a very fancy Wall, Floor, Columns, and Ceiling.[/list][h3]Changes[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Menu:[/b] Exiting the Free Admission version of the game will no longer take you to the Steam page.
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Made a quality improvement to the Ornate wallpaper.[/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Fixed a bug that would close the Inventory Window when Piet stepped slightly outside the edge of the room.
[/list]
[h2]Maker[/h2]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Full functionality of the Save/Open/Play windows with a controller. The D-Pad can be used to scroll up and down the level list, while the Start button can be used to instantly open a level once selected. Otherwise you can press the window’s buttons like usual with the lower face button (for instance, A on an Xbox Controller).
[*] Full functionality for painting tools on controllers.
[*] You can now open the context menu on a block by pressing the lower face button (A on Xbox) while the cursor is over it. 
[*] Full functionality of the context menu with a controller.
[*] You can now free-move a block with a controller by pressing and holding the lower face button (A on Xbox) on a block.
[*] Full functionality of all painting, color, and flip tools with a controller.
[*] Full functionality of the mini manual with a controller.
[*] Added a function to slow the cursor down on controllers. Holding down the Left Shoulder Bumper will slow the cursor.
[*] Non-Steam versions of Mondrian feature a brand new Share window, with buttons that will open your Levels and Thumbnails folders, and a link to our mod.io page.
[*] The Steam version has a new button in the Share window to bring you to the above page to upload your creations to mod.io.
[*] Added a Controller Map section to the mini manual. This map updates to match your currently selected controller layout from the Main Menu.[/list][h3]Changes[/h3][list]
[*] Cursor movement with a controller will now only snap to the grid when carrying a block.
[*] Updated some pages of the mini manual.[/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused blocks to Stamp far too quickly when using a controller.
[*] Fixed the “Nope” X appearing when grabbing a block with a controller.
[*] Fixed a bug where using the controller D-Pad would still nudge the level if the cursor was still over the Scale or Angle arrows.
[*] Fixed the Stamp cursor not appearing when using a controller.
[*] Fixed snap movement with a Controller not working at all grid sizes. It also no longer skips lines or snaps at different increments depending on how you’re moving the cursor.
[*] Fixed tooltips not disappearing when using a controller
[/list]
This update is now available for both Free Admission and Lifetime Pass players, so make sure to update!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/0054c1cd2902b6687ba0d307c146b226631b6397.jpg[/img]
As an added bonus, you may have noticed a note that mentions a new button in the Share window. This button will switch you over to a brand new mod.io interface! That's right, our [url=https://mod.io/g/mondrian]mod.io page is back online[/url]. These new buttons will guide you through the relatively simple process of uploading your creations to mod.io from their website (with a teensy bit of finagling involving MS Paint and zipping a file). If you've been active on Steam Workshop, we'd love to see you upload your creations over there as well.

You may have also noticed we mentioned "non-Steam versions" of the game. Well, as of today, [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i] is also available on [url=https://lantanagames.itch.io/mondrian-plastic-reality]itch.io[/url], [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/mondrian-plastic-reality/320515]GameJolt[/url], and a dedicated [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/g/mondrian_plastic_reality]Humble Gamepage[/url]! Free Admission is also now available on [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/mondrian-plastic-reality/downloads/mondrian-plastic-reality-free-admission]indieDB[/url]. The itch and Humble versions also include Steam Keys. In the coming weeks and months we'll be trickling the game out to other platforms as well, so keep an eye out and please welcome any new players to the community who show up!

Finally, as promised, the price of the game has dropped from $14.99 to $9.99 USD.

Thanks as always for your support, and for playing. Happy third anniversary! Let's make this the best [i]Mondrian[/i] update yet!
[i]- Danny[/i]

We will have a BIG blog post tomorrow and what to expect from Makersmas. But for now, here are the full patch notes. Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Makersmas Returns December 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/016bbe9b0a3ccb29ff4c180f24b8841f55cb6b89.jpg[/img]

Our annual holiday celebration, Makersmas, returns to [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i] on December 1! This year, we'll be doing things a little differently, and instead of a Competitive Gala, we will be running Makersmas as a Community Gala, which means most of the activity will take place outside of the game. Read on for how we'll be managing things a little differently this time around. We think you'll like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/e797029cfbfc40dea3df658351b2a2e9cf287bfb.png[/img]

[h1]Weekly Prompts[/h1]
Each week you'll be given a new prompt here on Steam, and it won't just be for [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] creations. You'll get to share your creations, your Museums, screenshots, gifs, videos, and more. Certain community actions, like using [b]#makersmas[/b] on Twitter, will add points to the [b]Community Gem Pool[/b]. When you finish a round in any Quick Play mode, or grab your daily Gems from the Gem Tree, you'll earn the Gems from the pool too! These Gems will be cumulative all month long, meaning the more you share, the more everyone earns. All you have to do is follow the weekly prompts here and on our Discord. We in turn will share your posts, and [i]Maker[/i] creations in particular on the [url=https://instagram.com/mondrianmakers]Mondrian Makers Instagram[/url] account. Let's see how high up we can get the Community Gem Pool before New Year's Eve!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/e797029cfbfc40dea3df658351b2a2e9cf287bfb.png[/img]
[h1]Charity Endeavor[/h1]
During December, we'll be jumping onto our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lantanagames]Twitch[/url] stream once in a while to raise money for [url=http://www.givekidsthearts.org/]Give Kids the Arts[/url] and the International Arts Foundation for Kids.

[url=https://www.givekidsthearts.org/?page_id=41][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/6eee4279579dbc0790b2379a45d5845576db33a8.jpg[/img][/url]

"Give Kids The Arts is a branch of the International Arts Foundation for Kids (IAFK), a registered 501(c)(3). We collect new art supplies, new and gently used music, and dance equipment, lessons, studio time, tickets to museums, shows, and concerts and distribute these items to less fortunate children in our communities where artistic pursuit can be difficult."

Our donation campaign for the month will go live on December 1, and we will be live every Thursday afternoon in December to reach or surpass our goal. [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lantanagames]Please join us[/url], follow and raid the channel, and donate if you can. Hope to see you there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/e797029cfbfc40dea3df658351b2a2e9cf287bfb.png[/img]
[h1]Incoming Update[/h1]
On November 30, version 1.4.5 of [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i] will go live. This update will also include brand new Makersmas and other Spotlight Artworks in the Museum. Makersmas does not officially start until the next day, but will go live automatically at the stroke of midnight EST, December 1, and will run through 11:59pm on December 31. As usual, while Makersmas is live, you'll be able to grab daily gifts from both trees in the Museum. If you want to grab the elusive "Makersmas Goodies" (open 10 Cosmetic Gifts), "Makersmas Riches" (open 10 Gem gifts), and "Makersmas Avarice" (open 40 gifts total) Achievements, you have the whole month to do it.

Updating to the latest version is necessary if you want the benefits of the Community Gem Pool. An internet connection is required to access Makersmas features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/e797029cfbfc40dea3df658351b2a2e9cf287bfb.png[/img]

We're extremely excited for this new take on Makersmas and we hope you'll come be a part of it! See you very very soon, and as always, thank you for playing.

[i]- Danny[/i]

notes.title: Art Hallow's Eve is here! Be a part of our Pumpkin Patch Gala.
notes.content:
[h1]It's a Pumpkin Carving Jamboree![/h1]
Happy Halloween and Spooky Month, everybody! This year, we're excited to step things up for our annual "Art Hallow's Eve" celebration. For those of you who are new here, every October we open up a Pumpkin Patch Gala, where you can use [i]Mondrian's[/i] level editor, [i]Mondrian Maker[/i], to create a Jack O'Lantern level and compete for fun prizes! Everyone is invited to participate, whether you're using the Free Admission demo or you're a Lifetime Pass owner. The contest will run from now until November 1.

The rules are simple:
[list]
[*] Create a Jack O'Lantern themed level in [i]Mondrian Maker[/i], with or without a template (you can use our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2615625792&searchtext=pumpkin]Pumpkin template on Steam Workshop[/url])

[*] Don't forget to follow our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1087050/discussions/9/3200367300169130368/]basic Gala submission guidelines[/url]
[/list]Never used [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] before? No problem! We put together a video tutorial last year on how to make a Jack O'Lantern. Give it a few minutes to get up to speed.

[previewyoutube=qstKMTuGerc;full][/previewyoutube]

Similarly, we will only be judging pumpkin-based Jack O'Lanterns as we lack the expertise to be critical of other squash, including but not limited to butternut, acorn, delicata, kabocha, and hubbard.

[*] 8400 Steam Points

notes.title: Mondrian 1.4.3 Available Now
notes.content:
[h1]What's New[/h1]
Hello everyone! The latest update for Mondrian, 1.4.3, is now available. Yes, we're overhauling the numbering system as it no longer felt like it was representing the true state of things. Instead of a [b]Season.Episode.Update.Fixes[/b] system, it is now [b]Season.Movement.Update[/b], which reflects the state of the Steam Workshop tags as well. All previous patch notes are being updated to match this new system too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/3913b9e9a05ec763f8817b49765077b54a92a383.jpg[/img]
So, the fun stuff. We're easing into this year's Art Hallow's Eve celebration with the inclusion of new Museum cosmetics which pay homage to the grandfather of spooky games. The Hangar wall, floor, columns, and ceilings (two of them) are now available in the Museum's cosmetics inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/07f6eb3d5dcc52aaaacbffd4edb11a7c1c6e8426.jpg[/img]
We're also introducing a brand new feature in the Museum which allows you to paint certain cosmetics any of 18 colors (the 12 primary colors + 6 shades of gray). Currently this feature exists on the Drywall and Painted Brick Wall, and it will be coming to other cosmetics in the very near future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/77d12c68ce9a71820f4ce63e6cf1a4715dcfdb4b.gif[/img]
You will also notice some minor changes throughout the game. We've paid a lot of attention on this update to improving the experience on Steam Deck, like introducing an animated Loading glyph, delaying the start of the point ticker in the Gem Chest, and increasing some text sizes on the Main Menu. Steam Deck players also have a more dedicated control scheme, with the left thumbpad now controlling the cursor with lower sensitivity, easing the experience in [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] in particular. If you are playing the game on Steam Deck, please continue to send us you're feedback and we'll continue to make the experience even better!

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Global:[/b] The Loading glyph is now animated!
[*] [b]Splash Screen:[/b] Added Loading glyph when starting the game and going to the Main Menu.
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Added Loading glyph when leaving the Game scene.
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] You will notice some icons in the Construction menu now feature paint splatter icons in the corner. This means these items can be painted! When you select them, you’ll then be prompted to select any of 18 colors (6 shades of gray and 12 primaries). After construction, these items will be painted in the color you selected. Painted Cosmetics are currently available for the Drywall and Painted Brick walls. This feature will be coming to even more cosmetics in the near future.
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Added new Hangar cosmetics for Art Hallow’s Eve. These are homages to a level of the same name from the grandfather of spooky games. They include a new Wall, Floor, Columns, and TWO ceilings!
[/list][h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Global:[/b] Adjusted version numbers for all historical and future versions of the game from 1.0 onward. The first number will now refer to a Season, the second a Movement (as denoted in Steam Workshop tags), and the third a minor update within a Movement.
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Increased font size on tooltips to improve readability on Steam Deck
[*] [b]Game:[/b] There is now a quarter-second delay when a level ends to finish the fade-out. This helps smooth out the experience on Steam Decks in particular.
[*] [b]Gem Chest:[/b] Point counter sound effects will no longer play before the fade-in has completed
[*] [b]Gem Chest:[/b] Added a slight visual and audio fade-in for the point counter
[*] [b]Gem Chest:[/b] The “Loading” glyph will now properly display in the lower-right hand corner when entering and exiting the screen
[/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Splash Screen:[/b] Fixed a bug which prevented Data files from copying over correctly.
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Fixed Bonus Banners not finishing their scale-out animation.
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Fixed the mouse cursor flickering when controllers are attached.
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Fixed inventory items not displaying names or prices while using a controller.
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Fixed Gesso color not loading as black when opening Mondrian Studio in Night Mode
[*] [b]Steam:[/b] Fixed a bug which caused the “You Dig on Multiverses” achievement to unlock too easily. If you already unlocked it, congratulations!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/81b12c33f1099faf74dbba084559d08cf8b6a03a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Art Hallow's Eve[/h1]
This year, we are trying something a little different with Art Hallow's Eve. The event is set to begin automatically right at the start of October, rather than us needing to force another update. You will need an internet connection to access the event, but when you do, you'll be able to join in on our annual Pumpkin Patch Gala, AND check out the brand new "Spooky Gem Hunt" mode that will run exclusively for the duration of the month. The Main Menu and Museum will of course get their annual makeovers, but the pumpkins in the Museum will be last year's Gala entries. This is a new tradition we will be continuing going forward, meaning if you submit a pumpkin to the Gala this year, it will appear in the Museum next year!

Art Hallow's Eve will begin this Saturday, October 1. Keep your eyes peeled for another post on everything happening during the event and a bit more info on Spooky Gem Hunt and the Pumpkin Patch Gala.

In the meantime, enjoy the update, happy second anniversary, and thank you for playing!
[i]- Danny[/i]

notes.title: “Art is for Everybody” Update Out Now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/9a15c4dda36ccd3a7822fed5823ddfe645a74331.jpg[/img]
[i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i] version 1.0.12 is now available, with a brand new Movement we’re calling “Art is for Everybody.” At Lantana Games, we truly believe anybody can create, and this update is the embodiment of that mantra, with one of the biggest updates to [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] yet, a brand new game mode, and loads of optimizations and bug fixes. Let’s dig in and see what’s new!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/30d63cd734f66c229e73d30c5c4c2123356e43e6.jpg[/img]
[h2]Mondrian Maker Improvements[/h2]
Back in March, we promised that we would put a lot of effort into improving controller functionality across the game for the sake of Steam Deck players and re-earning that “Full Controller Support” badge. We’ve made some enormous strides with this update! Many of the functions that previously had only mouse or, even worse, only keyboard controls in [i]Mondrian Maker[/i], now have redundant controls across mouse, keyboard, and controller, like nudging and modifier properties (D-Pads can be used, and the UI arrow buttons are finally clickable).

Some other changes should also speed up creation. For instance, the Trash Can under the Modifier Context Menu now clears all modifier data instead of deleting the block. The Varnish can is now a much safer, two-step process, first un-varnishing painted colors without removing their paint. We’ve added a dedicated control for instantly toggling the Shuffle Colors button between Painted and Dynamic (Z on keyboard or Top Face Button on a controller). Tooltips and the Mini Manual have been updated to reflect all the changes, and will keep being updated as more additions and fixes come in over the coming weeks.

While we’re far from done with [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] updates, we are curious to see what our Steam Deck players in particular think of these updates. It should now be possible to access every function of the editor, whether through the touchscreen, touchpad, controller sticks and buttons, or a combination thereof. Please send us your feedback and we will keep plugging away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/2118fb86b89297dd5236bd8bc520aa88dd44194d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Say Hello to Sudden Death[/h2]
Surprise, it’s another new Quick Play Mode! “Sudden Death” combines aspects of Time Trial, Gem Hunt, and the old boss levels from Abstraction in Beauty into quite a challenge. Players must survive for as many levels as they can, without a Wall to protect them. Of course, this also means no Wall Locks or Gem Shields. The moment you lose the ball it’s Game Over, and you are scored based on the number of levels you pass. Like Time Trial mode, there’s no Gem Chest screen until you win, but there ARE local and online leaderboards, plus new Achievements to bring the grand total to… well, you can guess.

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Added “Sudden Death” Quick Play Mode! In this mode, the Wall is missing, and you’re scored based on the number of Levels you survive. New Local and Steam Leaderboards have been added for each Difficulty in this mode, as well as 7 new achievements:
[olist]
[*] [b]Survivalist Apprentice:[/b] Survive for 5 Rounds on Sudden Death
[*] [b]Survivalist Professional:[/b] Survive for 10 Rounds on Sudden Death
[*] [b]Survivalist Artisan:[/b] Survive for 20 Rounds on Sudden Death
[*] [b]Endurance Wizard, Relaxing:[/b] Get a Top 10 High Score on Sudden Death Relaxing
[*] [b]Endurance Wizard, Easy:[/b] Get a Top 10 High Score on Sudden Death Easy
[*] [b]Endurance Wizard, Medium:[/b] Get a Top 10 High Score on Sudden Death Medium
[*] [b]Endurance Wizard, Hard:[/b] Get a Top 10 High Score on Sudden Death Hard
[/olist][*] [b]Maker:[/b] Lots of redundant controls have been added for accessibility, particularly on Steam Deck. These include:
[olist][*] You can now use the mouse to Nudge Blocks by left-clicking on the Nudge Arrows
[*] You can now use a controller D-Pad to nudge blocks or the level entirely
[*] You can now use the mouse to apply Shifting Modifiers by left-clicking on the Shift Arrows
[*] You can now use a controller D-Pad to adjust a block’s modifier properties like Phase Time and Shift Arrows
[*] You can now press Shift or use a controller’s Left Face Button (X on Xbox Controller) to flip the Phase Switch
[*] You can now exit Mondrian Maker with a controller by moving the cursor to the Exit button, or by pressing the View button
[/olist][*] [b]Maker:[/b] Added Z and a controller’s Top Face Button (Y on an Xbox Controller) as a shortcut for the Color Shuffle button. The Mini Manual has been updated to reflect this.[/list][h3]Changes[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Game:[/b] Cut default Wall Lock time in half. This means hitting a Wall Lock will now add 3 seconds of Lock Time on Fast, 4.5 seconds of Lock Time on Medium, and 9 seconds of Lock Time on Slow.
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Cut bombed Wall Lock time by 75%. This means bombs hitting Wall Locks with explosions will now add 1.5 seconds of Lock Time on Fast, 2.75 seconds of Lock Time on Medium, and 4.5 seconds of Lock Time on Slow.
[*] [b]Gem Chest:[/b] Optimized various functions
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] The “Trash” button in the Block Context Menu now clears all Mod data instead of deleting the block. Tooltips have been updated to reflect this change.
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] Cleaned up and optimized Hand Cursor code.
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] Thumbnails downloaded from Steam Workshop will now show in the Save, Load, Play, and Share menus. Note that this will only work for thumbnails just ending in “_preview.” Methods of automatically cleaning up thumbnail names with “_preview2,” “_preview3” etc. will be explored in a later update.
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] Updated the Context Menu, Block Modifiers, Quick Tips, Sharing, and Content Policy pages of the Mini Manual
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] Removing Varnish is now a two-step process. Right click the Varnish  Can once to remove the protective Varnishing from all blocks, or right click it TWICE to remove the Varnish AND Painted Colors from all blocks. Tooltips have been updated to reflect this change.
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] Clicking the Color Shuffle button or using one of the new Color Shuffle shortcuts, while carrying a block, will now change that block’s color back and forth between Painted and Unpainted colors.[/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Game: Fixed a bug that would cause Phase Block Hit and Shifting Block Hit achievement stats to add up too quickly.
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Fixed Background Color resetting when switching from the Color Palette tab to the Visual Effects tab after a color refill.
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Fixed Grayscale versions of backgrounds not initially loading if spelled “Grey.”
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] Fixed mouse movement on the cursor getting stuck if controller input was detected first.
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] The scrollbar will no longer scroll itself outside the bounds of the Save/Load window when using the mouse wheel.
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] Fixed thumbnails being too tall in the Save/Load/Play window if they weren’t saved at a 1:1 ratio.
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] Fixed a bug that prevented the Save and Load windows from working properly after Importing or Exporting a level.
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] Fixed pre-painted blocks having the Palette Button color rather than their painted color
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] Thumbnails in the Save/Load window will now properly appear behind notifications
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/620891a444a43616740e8db0a6b74980de71ab4a.jpg[/img][h2]Upcoming Events[/h2]
[strike]As this is the start of the “Art is for Everybody” Movement, it’s time to really see what our community can do. It all starts with the second [i]Mondrian Custom Tournament[/i] and design camp, in cooperation with Art Chops and Virtual Reload, hosted at The Esports Cave in Leander, TX. The camp runs from August 1-12, and features a full curriculum on learning [i]Mondrian Maker, Mondrian Studio[/i], and the game, in preparation for a Time Trial tournament, streamed live on Twitch on the last day. Competitors will once again be playing for fun prizes, with their creations immortalized on Steam Workshop. The camp is open to all young artists in the Greater Austin area, with one and two week options available. Visit the Eventbrite to learn more.[/strike]

Unfortunately due to timing and lack of sales, we have had to delay our upcoming educational program. We have every intention of bringing it back in the fall with a new approach to marketing and a perfected curriculum. We hope you'll join us then!

After the camp, we will be opening up a series of Galas which will be accessible for both Lifetime Pass and Free Admission creators. These Galas will be themed around subject AND input, meaning we are planning optional challenges to submit entries made using Controller, Touchscreen, and even Steam Deck. Keep an eye out for these!
Closing Out
The rest of the Summer is shaping up to be crazy. On top of that, we know the game’s second Anniversary and the Season of Creativity is sneaking up, so there’s a lot coming down the pike! Stay tuned because this ride is just getting started.

As always, thank you for playing.

notes.title: Announcing Mondrian Custom Tournaments!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/185f77d11a70cd580a0cc8ab55c3fb190660019c.png[/img]
On June 17, Virtual Reload and Wired Minds hosted the first ever [i][url=https://lantanagames.com/community/mct/]Mondrian Custom Tournament[/url][/i]. The goal was simple: run a week-long Summer Camp based around [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i], where campers  would create their own levels. The week would culminate in a Time Attack tournament where only their levels were played. The results were amazing. Nine campers learned [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] and [i]Studio[/i] in just a few days, and brought their A-Game to the tournament, streamed on Twitch at the end of the week.

You can watch the full stream of the tournament below. Keep in mind it's three hours long! So grab a cup of coffee and get ready to see some top level play from some of the most creative young minds in our community.
[previewyoutube=SVw5EVSwlLw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Latest Patch Notes[/h2]
Plenty of feedback came in from the camp, which has led to some important game updates and optimizations. Here are the 1.0.11f8 patch notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Made a minor change to Bomb Chain behavior. Now instead of the chain going off all at once, blocks will pop in sequence based on their distance to the center of the explosion. This has both optimization and gameplay benefits. With less happening at once, Bomb Chains are less likely to slow down the game. With Gems now also coming out in sequence rather than all at once, this makes grabbing the rewards from Bomb Chains much easier!
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Added a limiter to block pops, which prevents too many particles from spawning at once.
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Reduced antialiasing quality on Gems when more than 20 are visible on screen.
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Adjusted animation speeds on Block Pops.
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Darkened the limiter in Time Attack mode.
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] You can now use the suffix “Gray” or “Grey” in the Grayscale version of your backgrounds.
[/list]
[h2]Hosting Your Own Tournament[/h2]
If you're interested in hosting a tournament, we've created a [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfRUinbbXSWj0azREkoHhSgZDd1NfKYyWvHpxWGxQFDDK051Q/viewform]convenient Google Form[/url] you can fill out with your contact info and your vision of how you'd like your tournament to go. "Artist Collective Licenses" for [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i] are also now available. You can use these to buy multiple copies of the game for your cafe, classroom, or camp (make sure to [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/pccafe]register with the Steam PC Cafe program[/url]). We will be happy to provide direct training (usually remote, in some cases on-site) in the game's toolsets to your tournament participants.

The core of the [i]Mondrian Custom Tournament[/i] format is the allowance of letting you run it however you want. Single Elimination, Double Elimination, Round Robin, number of contestants, host, ads, streaming platform, merch, prizes, it's all up to you! We learned a lot from the first tournament, and still want you to have control over the content and delivery of your event, so we can only make some recommendations:
[list]
[*] 2-3 levels per participant, generally 12 levels minimum works best
[*] Make sure all levels are downloaded prior to the beginning of the event, only the levels you want to play are in the active Levels folder, and no content subscriptions are active on Steam Workshop (in other words, unsubscribe from everything before opening the game or it will download again)
[*] Custom Background Images can add even more branding or give participants more ways to share their creative skills with your audience.
[/list]Fill out the form above if you think a [i]Mondrian Custom Tournament[/i] would be right up your alley, and we'll be happy to work alongside you to build it, offer training, and make it as good as can be!

As always, thank you for playing! Hope to see you at the next tournament.
[i]- Danny[/i]

notes.title: The first Steam Deck-related update for Mondrian is Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/ccc419ba66c74d075dc5b061cd13a812bf3b4bc0.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Future is #OnDeck[/h1]
Greetings everyone! The latest update for [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i] is out. This will begin the slow trickle of updates throughout the rest of the year to achieve the "Runs Great on Steam Deck" verification. The biggest hurdle to overcome for this will be [i]Mondrian Maker[/i], which is currently based entirely on Mouse and Keyboard input. The current plan is to overhaul the entire UI and input code to be more in-line with [i]Mondrian Studio[/i], and create the ultimate interface for creativity on the go.

Since we're well aware of what we've built, we won't be submitting the game for Steam Deck verification until [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] is overhauled. However, don't let that stop you from trying out the game anyway! Believe it or not, we don't have a Steam Deck of our own, but would love to get some dedicated testers to send us feedback on game feel, stability, and ideas on what would work best for [i]Mondrian Maker[/i]'s revamped UI. Please get in touch if you own or have access to a Steam Deck. We'll be happy to set you up with a Lifetime Pass key and access to a dedicated Steam Deck testing branch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/aa79a2e58f5f4904c3668f8c5fe3b1b7aa60cb22.jpg[/img]
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
This patch applies to both [b]Lifetime Pass[/b] and [b]Free Admission[/b] players. The 1.0.11f2 update mainly adds more dedicated touchscreen controls for [i]Mondrian Studio[/i], but there are even more Steam Deck-centric additions. Here's the full list:
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Global:[/b] Live Events are now activated outside of game updates. This means you will no longer have to download a patch when any event goes live or ends. You will, however, need to be connected to the internet when the game starts to be able to access some live event features, such as Gala Contest uploads. Some events like Makersmas and Art Hallow’s Eve will still require a patch download for new content.
[*] [b]Menu:[/b] Added Steam Deck controller UI as "Modern" under Gameplay Options
[*] [b]Menu:[/b] Added controller names to the Input Selector (Colors, Shapes, Silver, Retro, and Modern)
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Added Steam Deck control guide to Pause menu
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Added Q and E as tab selection controls
[/list][h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Menu:[/b] Increased font size of Controller Input instructions
[*] [b]Game:[/b] You can no longer bring the Pause menu up while story is typing out in Adventure Mode
[*] [b]Story:[/b] Fixed incorrect wording in the Level 2 tutorial
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Improved touchscreen functionality for sliders and buttons
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] When Masking is set to On, the Negative and Canvas colors will now always switch to Black or White
[/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Game:[/b] More fixes for the touchscreen pause button
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Fixed keyboard controls not appearing in the story dialogue box in Adventure Mode when starting a level if you were, in fact, using keyboard/mouse controls
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Fixed corner logos being behind the negative space in Full Window captures
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Fixed keyboard and controller not being able to scroll to Canvas Fill in the Background Canvas tab
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused all sliders in a single tab to move together when using touchscreens
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] Adjusted some Save and Open window conditional ordering to try and fix levels not detecting block numbers[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/6c6366c05bf4d20bc638940fa0865178bb89ea74.jpg[/img]
[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
You can probably tell we're really excited about the Steam Deck, and especially what it can bring to the table in terms of content creation. We think [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] could be a truly euphoric experience on the platform, and the efforts we put in on the platform will help make [i]Mondrian[/i] a more complete package overall (like getting back to "Full Controller Support"). More will be on the way soon, and there's a LOT to get to in 2022. As always, can't wait to see what you create, and thank you for playing.
[i]- Danny[/i]

notes.title: Mondrian Free Admission Now Available!
notes.content:
The long wait is finally over: [i]Mondrian Free Admission[/i] is now available on Steam! The free version of [i]Plastic Reality[/i], [i]Free Admission[/i] gives you access to Endless mode, a handful of levels, [i]Mondrian Maker[/i], [i]Mondrian Studio[/i], and a small sampling of the background artwork and music that comes with the full game. If you don’t own the game yet, this is the perfect way to dip your toes into the water and see what’s on offer. You can pick it up on the game’s [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1087050/Mondrian__Plastic_Reality/]Steam Page[/url].

To see what’s different between Free Admission and the full, lifetime pass version of Mondrian – Plastic Reality, check out the chart below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/ceda355f47a8269fbc2536d2a895c269fa8d7982.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/166b2bc48c378eed37fde3b57a329beaae69cd58.jpg[/img]

[i]Free Admission[/i] will be kept up-to-date with the full game, meaning any bug fixes, changes, or in some cases, new features that would affect the full game, will also get updated. While you have full access to the [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] and [i]Mondrian Studio[/i] suite of tools, you cannot open levels in [i]Mondrian Maker[/i], and your [i]Mondrian Studio[/i] creations will be watermarked. You can still upload levels to Steam Workshop, but at the moment they may – MAY – not combine with levels from Lifetime Pass users. It is 100% our intention to let users creations combine in the one Workshop, whether they’re [i]Free Admission[/i] or [i]Lifetime Pass[/i] users, so if they don’t combine yet, just know we’re doing our due diligence to make that happen.

To celebrate the launch of [i]Free Admission[/i], we’re also offering a 20% discount on the full Lifetime Pass! This sale lasts for one week, until February 11.

[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/692687d10e014fbf061c5aa1b2c6b4c65cf83109.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Year, New Mode[/h2]
To ring in 2022, we’re excited to introduce Time Attack Mode! This new Quick Play mode challenges you to set a high score based on the amount of time you can survive. Grabbing Gems will add a couple seconds to your timer, while losing the ball hits your time with a big penalty. As usual, this all scales dynamically with Game Speed and Difficulty, but the clock always ticks down in real time. You also will not see the Gem Chest in Time Attack mode until the clock hits 0:00.00, with levels instantly loading one after the other, so don’t get too comfortable. The Gems you collect are still usable for decorating your Museum in Adventure, but your final score is based on the amount of time you survive, rounded up to the nearest second.

Like Arcade Mode, Time Attack features Steam Leaderboards, 4 in total (Relaxing, Easy, Medium, Hard). Reach the Top 10 to unlock brand new Steam Achievements! In fact, there are over 40 new Steam Achievements included in this update! Some may unlock the moment you start the game, depending on how much time you’ve put in previously, and others will take some doing because they are tracking brand new stats. Either way, hours of fun await!
[hr][/hr][h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]

You have until next Friday to submit, and for the first time ever, you can use Mondrian Free Admission to submit your creations. Once you’ve uploaded your creation to Steam Workshop, simply drop a link to it on our [url=https://discord.gg/BuC9xjUPx6][b]Discord[/b][/url] in the [i]#gala-submissions channel[/i]. Levels must be built in Mondrian Maker, thumbnails created in Mondrian Studio (external editing is okay), set to Publicly Visible, with “Level” and “Gala Entry” tags applied before the submission deadline. And as always, we’re looking for more events, more partnerships, more streaming and workshop opportunities, and into more Galas to throw for our excellent community. Hopefully this Winter will be as exciting as always!

2022 will certainly be an interesting year for us. Up to this point, Mondrian has been a fully premium experience. Now, with Free Admission, we are opening up our powerful creative tools to everyone, regardless of budget. We hope you’ll come be a part of our creative community, and make levels and artwork that help shine a positive light on what the game can do. notes.title: Looking Ahead - Mondrian Plans for 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/4153e532f0ec79677af833cdfde45c8635f3cdcd.jpg[/img]

Happy New Year to all our wonderful artists! 2021 was filled with trials and tribulations, but it's tough to be more excited than we are about where the last year took [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i]. Here's just a little summary of everything that happened with the game in the last year:

[list]
[*] The [b]Creators Update[/b] introduced [i]Mondrian Studio[/i], a built-in design suite to create Steam Workshop thumbnails and shareable social media images from your [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] creations
[*] Cross-promotional contests with our friends at SmartEgg Games and their wonderful [url=https://www.amazon.com/mondrianblocks]Mondrian Blocks[/url] tabletop puzzlegame led to unbelievable amounts of growth for the game and our social channels. Big thanks again to everyone participated! More of these to come in the future, keep an eye out.
[*] Introduction of live events like Art Hallow's Eve and Makersmas to encourage community participation.
[*] We brought the game to lots of digital events, like Nordic Games Conference, and finally returned to in-person events with the Indie Showcase at Balance Patch in Boston!
[*] Began hosting Creative Workshops on GamerJibe and Twitch
[*] Added slightly more in-depth tagging functionality to [i]Mondrian Maker[/i], so you can now make your levels private or friends only, plus submit them to any live event Gala contests we have ongoing.
[*] More big improvements to [i]Mondrian Maker[/i], like precision painting and more logical Z-ordering (new blocks are always on top)
[*] Lots of gameplay improvements, such as end-of-level proximity homing and increased Museum inventory size.
[*] Introduction of Columns, Ceilings, and Baseboards in the Museum, resulting in (currently) over 10 BILLION different Museum spaces you can build!
[*] Ended the year by getting [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i] Intel™ Iris Graphics certified!!![/list][previewyoutube=6AXCykRBiVw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]2022 Plans and Goals[/h2]
With such an enormous year behind it, how could we possibly top it? Well, there are two - just two - high priority goals we have for 2022:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/51e906a1c8e08e67517180d866f1f4913e1f1ada.jpg[/img]
[olist]
[*] [b]Steam Deck:[/b] We have already received confirmation that the game runs, looks, and sounds great on Steam Deck! With today's 1.0.10f9 update, we've also made sure that images exported from [i]Mondrian Studio[/i] will no longer awkwardly crop at screen resolutions other than 1080p, meaning creating [i]Mondrian[/i] levels and artworks on the go will be easier than ever! That said, [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] itself, admittedly, has a ways to go to be completely Deck-ready, so our highest priority for the beginning of the year will be making sure Touchscreen and Controller functionality is working everywhere. [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] will be receiving an extra amount of attention in this regard. We want it to be possible to make creations with just a controller, while also making a combination of controller and touchscreen functions feel not just natural, but beautiful. [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] needs to be a show-stopper, and a killer app for all Steam Deck owners. 
[*] [b]Episode 2:[/b] I know I haven't talked about this in a while and it's way overdue. Wish I could say more, but what I will say is this: a good portion of development time last year was devoted to improving our internal storywriting tool in preparation for Episode 2, and that is still getting picked at. Ultimately, all story data for an episode will get contained in a single file, so even Episode 1 will receive an update. I'm hoping there'll be more to say in a few months, especially with regards to where the story is going, but keep your fingers crossed we can get Episode 2 out this year, and get on a steady stream of story content from that point forward.
[/olist]Two more endeavors this year include the DLC galleries and a demo version. While both are still in a very early, pre-production state, they both fit with our mantra of making creativity as widely available as it can be. The tricky part is that the demo version does need to include regular gameplay, [i]Maker[/i], AND [i]Studio[/i], so the current plan is that the demo will include ~10 levels, Endless Mode,[i] Mondrian Maker[/i] without the Open Level window, and [i]Mondrian Studio[/i] with a watermark and corner logos forced on. However, it will also be fully compatible with Steam Workshop, so any levels you want to share, you can, and any levels you want to play in Endless, you can play. While it won't be possible to play these levels in Test mode since [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] won't have its open window, you will be able to test out anything you make, and get back to it if you purchase the game or... just never close it. 😂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/9e6caaea8611e387a30f8bcff2db205b7dc7a5f2.jpg[/img]

Ideally, this demo will be more like a Free Version than just a demo, and kept up-to-date with the Premium version of the game. Expect more news on this very soon!

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]
The keen-eyed among you probably noticed a pretty sizeable patch was pushed this morning. The game has indeed been updated to version 1.0.10f9! This will be the last addition to the Anniversary Update Movement, with the next Movement due out later this winter/early Spring. This particular patch has some exciting new additions to [i]Mondrian Studio[/i] to help you mix up your thumbnails even more, and of course requisite bug fixes and adjustments. Plus, we have updated the core game engine, to help with text rendering times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/640a55e46e981205ea0d06845f3ab141ee75a635.jpg[/img]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Added a “Negative Color” function under the Custom Framing tab, which lets you set the color of the Negative Space outside the frame. You can choose between the day/night mode Gesso Color, the current Frame Color, or the current Primary Color.
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Added a “Transparency” slider under the “Background Canvas” tab, which lets you control the transparency strength of background images. Default is 50%.
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Added a “Canvas Fill” slider under the “Background Canvas” tab, which lets you control the color behind the background image. You can choose between the day/night mode Gesso color, the current Frame color, or the Primary Color.
[/list][h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Global:[/b] Ended the “Makersmas” event
[*] [b]Global:[/b] Updated core game engine to the latest version, which may result in slightly improved text rendering
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Reworked Snapshot Capture to be based on screen width/height percentage, rather than the pixel position of the Gallery Frame. This has fixed the issue of captures being cropped awkwardly at resolutions other than 1080p.
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Limited functionality across the Custom Framing, Color Palette, and Background Canvas tabs when in Mask mode to only the options that will not interfere with masking
[/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Fixed story and tutorial dialogue loading from campaign progress, rather than the selected level
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Fixed story levels unlocking by continuously beating previously completed levels
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Fixed a bug where 4 image selection arrows would be created in the Background Canvas tab rather than 2
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Fixed one-color background images resetting to the Primary Color when selecting the Background Canvas tab under the Random color harmony
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Fixed thumbnail images exporting in an awkwardly cropped state with black borders when saving or copying an image at screen resolutions other than 1080p
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/f91dd7461add1f909b3a94133299d3a8aaac6ec4.jpg[/img]

Now that the New Year has hit, it's back to the grind. Top priority is getting that Steam Deck verification as quickly as possible, while also trickling out other updates and keeping up support as we've always done. While there is no specific roadmap for 2022, there's lots to do, and all of it doable, but we'd prefer to do it with your help, so please make sure to Like and Share this post, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1087050/Mondrian__Plastic_Reality/]buy a copy of the game for a friend[/url] while it's still on sale (Winter Sale ends Wednesday!), or [url=https://www.redbubble.com/people/lantanagames/shop]grab some merch off our Redbubble[/url].

Thank you all so much for playing! Let's make 2022 ours.
[i]- Danny[/i]

notes.title: Happy Makersmas!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/918eadbd541580b1983a2120202931f32ed0bfe9.jpg[/img]
Ah, Makersmas. That most obscure of artistic Holidays has once again graced us with its modernist beauty, and bestowed upon us gifts from a plastic reality beyond the canvas.

Yes friends, our annual celebration of creativity has returned. We have a LOT in store for the entire month of December, so buckle up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/e797029cfbfc40dea3df658351b2a2e9cf287bfb.png[/img]
[h1]What is Makersmas?[/h1]
Makersmas is a celebration of creativity, and cannot happen without you! For the month of December, our Artwork tab is open to anything you're working on: [i]Mondrian Studio[/i] creations, more traditional works, music, your Etsy, you name it. Think of our Community page as a little popup arts and crafts fair. Anything you're selling, SOMEBODY is buying!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/6a4b5eb024e73696a9830c11542f4952c0f4ca95.jpg[/img]

[h1]What is there to do during Makersmas?[/h1]
First and foremost, in the game's Adventure Mode, you will notice a Green Pine and Red Crystalline tree in the Museum. The Green Tree will give you daily cosmetics that you can use in your Museum, and the Red Tree will give you daily Gem Bonuses! We've updated the Green Tree with EVERY COSMETIC FROM THE LAST YEAR, including all the columns, ceilings, and baseboards; the Porcelain Collection; and the Art Hallow's Eve, Autumn Barn, and brand new Icy packs. More than 50 cosmetics have been added in total, so you're bound to get something great!

Each week we will be doing different things in terms of community involvement. This includes:
[list]
[*] Themed [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] Contests with new Holiday and Wintry templates
[*] Steam Key Giveaways
[*] Twitch Sub Giveaways
[*] POAPs, Custom Frames, and other stocking stuffers
[*] Cross-Promotional Opportunities with some old friends
[*] Celebratory Livestreams
[*] Discord Stage Art Discussions with Special Guests
[/list]As mentioned above, the Artwork section here on Steam is yours to self-promote! Share your works and we'll help signal boost as best we can. We'll also have new, Makersmas themed merch (yup, that means ugly sweaters!) available on our Redbubble Store within the next couple of weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/e797029cfbfc40dea3df658351b2a2e9cf287bfb.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
Of course, it wouldn't be a Mondrian update if we hadn't gone above and beyond with new additions and fixes, so here are the full patch notes for the 1.0.10f7 update!
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Global:[/b] Activated the Makersmas event! This means snow, as well as a general Bluish color harmony, on the Main Menu, and the return of the Makersmas Trees in the Museum. The Green Tree gives you free Cosmetics, and the Red Tree gives you a random number of Gems. Grab your daily gifts to help you build out your space, and snag the limited-time Makersmas Riches, Goodies, and Avarice Achievements. Makersmas runs through January 1, 2022.
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Added the Icy Cosmetic pack for Makersmas
[list]
[*][b]Wall:[/b] Ice Castle
[*][b]Floor:[/b] Frosted Metal
[*][b]Ceiling:[/b] Vaulted Igloo
[*][b]Baseboard:[/b] Frosted Victorian
[*][b]Column:[/b] Ice Pillar
[/list][*] [b]Museum:[/b] Added cosmetics from the last year to the gift pool in the Green Tree
[*] [b]Studio:[/b] Added a “Mask” slider to the VFX tab. This slider displays your creation in strict Black & White (switch on Night Mode for an inverted version). By pressing the Copy to Clipboard button, you can then quickly paste it into the graphics editor of your choice and use these masks to create transparent images out of your creations! Check out our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2667817566]Masking Guide[/url] for more details.

notes.title: One Year In! Happy Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/95f2c44f6d4d1210e8c74fe3bead693c40c1c548.jpg[/img]
[h1]It's our Biggest Update since Launch![/h1]
Happy anniversary, beautiful artists! One year ago today, [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i] launched on Steam. It's been a slow buildup, but in that time we've introduced a lot of amazing features, like turning the Museum into a live events space and adding in the [i]Mondrian Studio[/i] design suite. There's been no shortage of big updates over the last year, but this one takes the birthday cake! So let's explore just a little bit of what this update has to offer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/309b56eb310596c0ec1c9f644d706d044306ab14.jpg[/img]
[h2]Massive Museum Additions[/h2]
We had previously calculated a total of two million or so possible gallery spaces you could build in your Museum. However, that number has now skyrocketed to an ASTRONOMICAL SIX BILLION possible spaces. How? Ceilings, columns, and baseboards. Thanks to these brand new cosmetic additions, you'll be able to vary up the look of your space like never before. Personalize your gallery the way YOU want with 12 column styles, 10 ceilings, and 17 baseboards. As always, more cosmetics will be on the way in the future, especially with the holidays coming up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/21535faeea49b8f5185a52d9aa1e35270911dd11.jpg[/img]
[h2]Support for Full HD Background Images[/h2]
Want to really show off your skills in your Steam Workshop thumbnails? Now you may use Full HD background images (1920x1080) instead of the traditional chunked backgrounds the game has always used! All you need is a subfolder in the game's Backgrounds folder, and two images. Here's what to do:
[list]
[*] In the Main Menu, select Options and then "Open Local Content"
[*] Browse to the game's Backgrounds folder
[*] Create a new folder here named after your background image (for example, [b]My Photo[/b])
[*] Paste in two 1920x1080 JPG images. They must share a name with the folder. One should be full color (ie [b]My Photo.jpg[/b]) and one should be an Inverted Black & White image with the word Gray attached as a suffix ([b]My PhotoGray.jpg[/b]).[/list] Backgrounds you import can display in the Main Menu, the Local Leaderboard, and in the Game itself. You can also select your background in the "Background Canvas" tab of [i]Mondrian Studio[/i] to be used in Full Color, One-Color, or Black & White mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/2f221bbc4fc252d22faa7a92f460a03bab7bab0b.jpg[/img]
[h2]A Massive Number of Fixes[/h2]
There are too many changes and fixes to list them all here, but needless to say, it's been a busy few months! Everything from experience-killers to the most obscure, once-in-a-lifetime occurrences has been squashed, with the intention of giving you one of the smoothest arcade experiences you could ever imagine. No matter the level, game speed, or difficulty, we think you'll be very happy with what's been brought to the table. Read the nearly 2 pages (!!!) of Patch Notes below for the full details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913336/5103750c3135e694d905534fa2e03d40afa43bd5.jpg[/img]
[h1]All the other Happenings[/h1]
Things don't stop with the Anniversary Update! In just over a week, we'll be running our first ever Pumpkin Carving Competition as part of [url=https://twitter.com/ArtChops/status/1439786820384935938]ArtChops' Halloween Event[/url]. The pumpkin you see above will be uploaded to Steam Workshop late next week as a template, and you'll be free to modify it as you see fit to make your own Jack O'Lantern level! However, you're free to get a head-start if you wish, but levels without the incoming Halloween Steam Workshop tag won't be accepted, so hold off on submitting until that's live!

And yes, this contest will include prizes. We're still budgeting this out so expect some updates on this on or before October 1.

What else is new? Oh yeah, we made [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lantanagames]Twitch Affiliate[/url]! Streams go up basically every weekday at 3:30pm Eastern time, mostly Mondrian and development streams, but also other indie games, replays of old talks/panels, and [i]Sea of Thieves[/i]. Follow and subscribe, and make sure to say hi in chat!

Oh yeah, all 200 Punka Lisas are now available for you NFT collectors out there, so check out our [url=https://opensea.io/lantanagames]profile on OpenSea[/url] to grab yours!

We've also started a [url=https://www.clubhouse.com/club/mondrian-makers]Mondrian Makers Clubhouse[/url] if you're into that kind of thing. If you feel like chatting about making Mondrian levels or want to give us some feedback on what you'd like to see in the game, join the Club and come chat!

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]All[/b]: Added support for full background art images (1920x1080). Use of background chunks is also still supported. To add your own backgrounds, go to Options > Browse Local Content. Go to the game’s Backgrounds folder and create a folder named for your background (ex: photograph). Paste two versions of your background image in this folder: a full color one (photograph.jpg) and an inverted grayscale one (photographGray.jpg). We recommended inverting the image so it remains properly shaded in-game.
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Added different prompts to the Pause menu depending on game mode
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Added some functionality to veer the ball in toward blocks when there are fewer than 10 Regular blocks left in a level. The maximum distance at which the ball can veer toward a block is determined by difficulty. This also only applies to Regular blocks. Splitters, Teleporters, and Grays are not affected by this system.
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Added Column, Baseboard, and Ceiling decorations. With nearly 40 new decorations in total, there are now over 6 billion (with a B!!!) possible Museum spaces you can build. Mix and match to build your space!
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] Added the music tracks from the Museum, which all play on Shuffle
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] The “Exit Game” button now starts highlighted when quitting
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Added an in-game adjustment for changing Game Speed, rather than just saving the value to the settings file
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Added overrides to keep Adventure Mode levels in Analogous Color Schemes (meaning anything but De Stijl and Grayscale, at least for Episode 1) 
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Tied Wildcard swirl and fade to Gamespeed value
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Doubled the number of animation frames and added a slight fade-out to block pops
[*] [b]Game:[/b] If Block Groove is on, levels will still switch off Block Groove automatically if there are more than 200 blocks present (previously 150). However, when there are fewer than 200 blocks, Block Groove will switch back on. Control over this will be even more granular in an upcoming update.
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Increased inventory size from 3x6 to 4x6
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Updated rendering for Heavy Boards and Diamond Metal floor
[*] [b]Gem Chest:[/b] Reworked interstitial messages
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] The “Import” button no longer appears in the Inactive Levels tab of the Open menu
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] Increased the time it takes for the next drop to block when holding down left click in Stamp Mode
[*] [b]Maker:[/b] The time between stamping blocks also now resets when left click is released
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]All:[/b] Fixed the cursor in the Pause Menu ending up behind Studio objects, particularly the Gallery Frame & negative space
[*] [b]All:[/b] Fixed and eliminated all the quick flashes of white in Night Mode when changing scenes
[*] [b]Splash Screen:[/b] Fixed Splash Screen not appearing in Night Mode
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Fixed rough-ish fade in
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Fixed Splash Idling not counting time when Controllers are not attached
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Fixed the ball, wall, and paddle being low-contrast grays in Grayscale color harmonies
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Fixed being able to Pause the game before the “Ready” animation has finished
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Fixed Bomb sound effects sometimes not playing

notes.content:
[h1]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/h1]
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Introducing Mondrian Studio, accessible by hitting Save & Exhibit in Mondrian Maker. This toolset replaces Gallery Mode and gives you some sliders to adjust the frame size, crop, background, level colors, and more. It can also be used to quickly save JPG thumbnails with the right name and in the right directory to upload your creations to Steam Workshop!
[list]
[*][b] Custom Framing:[/b] This tab gives you Sliders to access Crop Marks, Negative Space, Frame Ratio, and Frame Rotation
[*][b] Color Palette: [/b]This tab lets you choose between the 12 primary colors, 10 analogous color scheme styles, scheme widths in 30° increments, and min and max brightness between 0% and 100%. Note that these changes do not happen in real time and you’ll need to click the Fill Button to change your creation’s color scheme.
[*][b] Background Canvas:[/b] This tab lets you choose a background image,  switch between Full Color, One Color, and Black & White variants, or switch the background off and on entirely. Note that One Color variants will take the Primary Color from the Color Palette tab.
[*] Visual Effects: This tab lets you toggle the game’s various visual effects, including CRT Monitor, Film Grain, and Night Mode.
[*][b] Snapshot Capture:[/b] Finally, the piece de resistance. The Snapshot Capture tab lets you save images of your creation based on the setup you’ve created in Gallery Mode. Capture Size lets you choose the size of the image, including the full Frame, Interior only, Frame + Crops, or the Full Window. You can also add various Mondrian and Lantana Games logos to the corners if you like. Use the Save function to save a properly named Thumbnail where the game needs it to upload your creation to Steam Workshop, or the Copy function to paste it directly into a chat, onto a social media post, or into external graphics editing software.

[list]

[*][b] Game:[/b] Fixed the possibility of a background image not loading when Backgrounds were still turned on
[*][b] Game:[/b] Fixed Triad 2 color 3 not generating on paddle, ball, or wall objects
[*][b] Museum:[/b] Fixed Y-Positioning on Tall Tapered Mahogany pedestals
[*][b] Museum:[/b] Fixed rendering on Chevron Wood floor

This never got developed and has never been a requirement. Sorry for the confusion! The Tooltip now says what the individual buttons do in the Play Your Level window instead.

notes.title: BostonFIG Virtual Indie Games Fest
notes.content:
[h1]Heading Home[/h1]
Happy New Year, everyone! With Makersmas coming to a close (and what a fun first Makersmas it was!) we're spinning our event schedule up for the rest of 2021. Obviously the world is still in flux, but we're going to do our best to keep up with some kind of consistent event schedule in Mondrian itself, and attend any digital or real expos we can.

First up is the [url=https://www.eventbrite.com/e/bostonfig-fest-virtual-tickets-129017660295]BostonFIG Virtual Indie Game Fest[/url] THIS SATURDAY! The event runs from 10am-5pm EST, and features [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i] and tons of other indie games. The event is Pay What You Want and takes place on Gather.Town, an almost Zelda-like web game for social meetups, digital offices, parties, and more! Our plan for the day is to demonstrate the Museum's capabilities as a digital gallery, with the goal of opening what we're calling the PopBlock Gallery sometime this Spring. Take a tour of the space right here, and sign up at the link above to not miss out!

[previewyoutube=sIOATQp38Wo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]The PopBlock Gallery[/h1]
The PopBlock Gallery is a new endeavor we're trying out with the game, and will play host to independent artists from around the world. It will include custom Museum spaces, new Museum decorations, exclusive levels, stories, and links to find out more about the artists involved. These galleries will be our DLC, and will cost between $2.99 & $8.99 USD, depending on the size of the exhibit, the number of artists involved, etc. The DLC will go to support the artists/organizations and they will be a great way for you to support the arts and our continued development of [i]Mondrian - Plastic Reality[/i].

[url=https://lantanagames.com/museum/]Learn more on our website![/url]

[h1]Update Plans[/h1]
The next update will be focusing on the game's Gallery Mode. The plan is to give it a proper UI, accessible via mouse & controller, with the following functionality:
[list]
[*]Change Frame Size
[*]Rotate Frame 90­­°
[*]Change Background
[*]Toggle Background On/Off
[*]Toggle Frame On/Off
[*]Toggle Negative Space
[*]Toggle Crop Marks
[*]Change Primary Color
[*]Change Color Scheme
[*]Capture Thumbnail (dynamic with frame, crop marks, and negative space)
[/list]
Once this is ready to go, uploading your levels to Steam Workshop will be that much easier, as you'll have all the control you need to capture the perfect Thumbnail, and the game will do it for you AND save it to the right place with the right name! For now you can always check the game guides for our tutorial on how to capture & save a Thumbnail until we get this update out (figure on February).

[h1]Some Small Updates[/h1]
Finally, we've pushed a small update to bring about the end of Makersmas and start the New Year off on the right foot, so here are the patch notes:
[h2]Game[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Turned off the snow
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Took down the Makersmas decorations. Thank you all for a wonderful, artsy Holiday celebration! We’ll absolutely be doing some other events like this during the year and of course Makersmas 2021 will be even better
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Levels you’ve already downloaded & are in your Levels or Inactive Levels folder will no longer re-download
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Fixed the cursor staying as a hand outside of the Difficulty selection buttons in Lightbox galleries
[/list]
[h2]Mondrian Maker[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the workshop tag to “BostonFIG” to coincide with Saturday’s expo. Will be updated again in a couple weeks!
[*] Increased the width of the Share Window text box to prevent cutoffs
[*] Added a check for Steam Connection before displaying the “Share to Steam” button
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Mondrian Maker not going to Testing or Gallery Modes when Save & Play or Save & Exhibit was clicked
[/list]
As always, please let us know if you run into any issues and we'll get them fixed up ASAP. Thank you for playing, and have an excellent [url=https://www.eventbrite.com/e/bostonfig-fest-virtual-tickets-129017660295]BostonFIG[/url]!

[i]- Danny[/i]

notes.title: Mondrian Maker & Workshop Fixes - 1.0.7 Now Available
notes.content:
Hi everyone. First off, I hope you've all had a wonderful Christmas, Hanukkah, Kwanza, and most importantly, Makersmas so far! It's been a very exciting time for us, what with all these massive updates hitting for the game left and right. This latest patch is no exception, as it fulfills the very promise of Makersmas: THE ABILITY TO MAKE STUFF!

Why mince words: Mondrian Maker had a pretty serious bug up until this point. The issue was a holdover from the old level format from the game's Early Access days, when block ordering was done very linearly, and a lot was dependent on each block's blockNumber value. This issue has been addressed by reassigning all blockNumber values whenever you save a level. The advantage to this is it not only fixes the above issue, but blocks will never got lost in the save process again. PHEW!

Next, to go along with this, downloading [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1087050/workshop/]Workshop[/url] subscriptions from the Main Menu has also been fixed, so if you grab any of the new Makersmas levels, you'll be able to play them! Plus, if you upload any Creations of your own, other players can finally check them out too. NEATO!

A few tweaks have also come to the Museum to smooth out some sound effects and object ordering. Here are the full patch notes for both the game/Museum and Mondrian Maker.

[h2]Game[/h2]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Overall:[/b] Updated Steamworks API
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Added text to Workshop notifications for both confirmations and errors on Subscription downloads
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Museum:[/b] Rebalanced Gem RNG to make 1000 a bit less common, and 500 and 2000 a bit more common
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Main Menu: Fixed Workshop Subscriptions not downloading. Get to makin’ stuff!
[*] Museum: Fixed artpieces spawning behind paintings
[*] Museum: Moved prize sound effects onto different channels to fix interruptions
[/list]
[h2]Mondrian Maker[/h2]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked Block Numbers to never fall out of order. Numbering now gets entirely reset on loading a level, saving a level, and assigned individually when placed, based on the total number of blocks, rather than a global block iterator value.
[*] Thanks to the above fixes, blocks will no longer go “missing” in the level data
[*] Fixed a bug that would load into Testing Mode when sharing to Steam Workshop, if the Play window had been brought up before the Share window
[/list]
Finally, in case you haven't heard, we're celebrating Makersmas, a holiday dedicated to self-promotion and all things creative! With the latest Mondrian Maker fixes, we'd love to see what you can cook up and share on Steam Workshop. We'll even share it further at our [url=https://instagram.com/mondrianmakers]Mondrian Makers Instagram![/url] We're posting one holiday themed level every day for the next couple of weeks too, so be sure to grab these and add them to your level collection. As they say, variety is the spice of life!

On a personal note, tomorrow is New Years, my birthday is a few days later, and I... really need a break. Like, seriously. Getting [i]Mondrian Maker[/i] and Workshop fixed nearly gave me a heart attack. So other than uploading the Christmas levels and taking down the Makersmas trees on the 15th (there's still time to get your Achievements!!!), I think I need to take a few days off. I'm also not 100% sure what's gonna come next, but I do know there's more neat stuff already in the works for the Museum, and I'm absolutely looking forward to making that part of the game even more special in the new year. But for now, I sleep, and maybe catch up on my overeating.

Be safe, be merry, be creative, have a happy New Year, and thank you for playing!
[i]- Danny[/i]
